events.title: Fall Bird Walk in Star K Ranch Open Space
events.description: Free; ages 8+. Register by Nov. 5; minors need a registered adult. Guided outdoor birdwatching, not a drop-off program.
events.locationLabel: Star K Ranch / Morrison Nature Center, 16002 E. Smith Road, Aurora
events.costLabel: Free; no mandatory fee shown on the public registration page
events.audienceLabel: Ages 8+; every minor must attend with a registered adult. Not a drop-off program.
events.registrationLabel: Registration required through November 5, 2026. Closing hour is not published. Register the accompanying adult as well as the child.
events.availabilityLabel: Limited registration was offered when checked October 22. Availability can change; check the organizer before making plans. Outdoor conditions may affect the walk.

events.title: Stewardship Saturdays for Families
events.description: Free; all ages. Registration required by Nov. 12. Help care for local open space with a family stewardship activity.
events.locationLabel: Morrison Nature Center at Star K Ranch, 16002 E. Smith Road, Aurora
events.costLabel: Free; no mandatory fee shown on the public registration page
events.audienceLabel: All ages; a family stewardship program
events.registrationLabel: Registration required through November 12, 2026, despite the drop-in-style activity format. Closing hour is not published.
events.availabilityLabel: Limited registration was offered when checked October 22. Availability can change; check the organizer. Meet at the nature center and prepare for outdoor work with closed-toe shoes and sun protection.

events.title: DMNS Free Night and Free Day: November dates
events.description: Free general admission only. Special exhibitions, planetarium and theater cost extra. Two separate November visits.
events.timeLabel: Nov. 7: 5–10 p.m.; Nov. 16: 9 a.m.–5 p.m. MST
events.locationLabel: Denver Museum of Nature & Science, 2001 Colorado Boulevard, Denver, CO 80205
events.costLabel: Free general admission; ticketed temporary exhibitions, planetarium and theater are separate and not included
events.audienceLabel: Family-friendly museum visits; no formal minimum age is stated
events.registrationLabel: No general-admission ticket or reservation is needed on these free dates; walk up. Optional ticketed experiences have their own charges and booking rules.
events.availabilityLabel: The November 16 hours use the museum’s published regular opening hours. Check current opening information before traveling.
events.recurrence_label: Two separate sessions: November 7 and November 16 only

events.title: Mile High Tree: November nights
events.description: Free outdoor light-and-music shows. This listing covers November nights only; the wider holiday season continues in December.
events.timeLabel: 5–10 p.m. MST; music-and-light shows every 15 minutes
events.locationLabel: Tivoli Quad, Auraria Campus, 1000 Larimer Street, Denver
events.costLabel: Free admission to the Mile High Tree; nearby shopping, food and other attractions are separate
events.audienceLabel: Family-friendly outdoor display; free for all visitors
events.registrationLabel: No visitor reservation requirement is posted for the tree. This listing does not include a drone-show, market or carousel booking.
events.availabilityLabel: The organizer advertises the wider season through December 31. Only November nights are listed here. Check organizer weather or cancellation updates before traveling.

events.title: Castle Rock Starlighting
events.description: Free entry; food costs extra. Star lighting and fireworks depend on weather and fire danger.
events.timeLabel: 2–6 p.m. MST; ceremony 5 p.m.; star lighting about 5:30 p.m.
events.locationLabel: Historic Wilcox Square and downtown Castle Rock, including Festival Park at 300 Second Street, Castle Rock, CO 80104
events.costLabel: Free general admission; optional food, drink and shopping purchases extra
events.audienceLabel: Family community celebration; no formal minimum age is stated
events.registrationLabel: No attendee registration requirement is posted. Vendor registration and vendor sellouts are separate from public attendance.
events.availabilityLabel: Star lighting is planned for about 5:30 p.m.; fireworks depend on weather and fire danger. The park address identifies Festival Park, not a confirmed ceremony-stage location. Check the organizer for final event information.

events.title: Parker Mayor’s Holiday Lighting
events.description: Free entry; food costs extra. Free s’mores for the first 1,000 guests only. Lighting at 6 p.m.
events.locationLabel: O’Brien Park, 10795 Victorian Drive, Parker, CO 80138
events.costLabel: Free admission; food vendors extra. Free s’mores for the first 1,000 guests only
events.audienceLabel: Family holiday celebration; no formal minimum age is stated
events.registrationLabel: No attendee registration requirement is posted.
events.availabilityLabel: Check town event updates and access information before traveling. Limited complimentary s’mores are not guaranteed.

events.title: Hometown Holiday Experience: November character dates
events.description: Free characters, Nov. 28–29, noon–3 p.m.; encounters not guaranteed. Food and skating (if operating) are separate.
events.timeLabel: Character appearances noon–3 p.m. MST each day
events.locationLabel: Downtown Parker: start at Schoolhouse Plaza, 19650 E. Mainstreet; Discovery Park, 20115 E. Mainstreet; and O’Brien Park, 10795 Victorian Drive, Parker, CO 80138
events.costLabel: Free holiday walk and character appearances; shopping, food and ice skating (if operating) are separate and not included
events.audienceLabel: Family holiday outing; no formal minimum age is stated
events.registrationLabel: No visitor reservation requirement is posted. Characters roam during the published hours; a particular character encounter is not guaranteed.
events.availabilityLabel: This listing covers the two November character dates only. The wider weekend character program continues through December 20; the decorative walk has a longer season. Do not assume staffed character appearances all day.

events.description: Free; families with ages 5–teen. Registration required by Nov. 2 at 5 p.m. MST. Share tabletop games, snacks and music.
events.locationLabel: Southglenn Library, Children’s Area, 6972 S. Vine Street, Centennial, CO 80122
events.costLabel: Free under Arapahoe Libraries’ event policy; snacks included; no mandatory fee disclosed
events.audienceLabel: Designed for families with children ages 5 through teens
events.registrationLabel: Registration required; registration closes November 2, 2026 at 5 p.m. MST.
events.availabilityLabel: Limited registration was offered when checked October 22. Places can fill before the deadline; check the organizer’s current registration status.
